name: spillway
description: Adopt spillway in a repository, operate the home pool, and diagnose the fallback CI from Claude Code.

pve_host.title: Proxmox host
pve_host.description: ssh destination of the Proxmox host that runs the pool VM (SPILLWAY_PVE_HOST). Leave empty for pve-01.

ssh.title: ssh client
ssh.description: ssh client deploy/pool.sh uses (SPILLWAY_SSH), for example ssh.exe in WSL. Leave empty for ssh.

net.title: Pool network
net.description: First three octets of the pool's /24 (SPILLWAY_NET), as given to the installer. Leave empty for 10.98.0.

checkout.title: spillway clone
checkout.description: Your local git clone of spillway. /spillway:pool runs deploy/pool.sh from it, and its update command installs that clone's HEAD in the VM. Leave empty to use the plugin's own copy (every command except update).
